status: Prespecified before comparator fitting; development cohort already inspected by earlier studies

clustering.scope: One label-free vocabulary over all 177 host proteomes and one over all 94 phage proteomes, shared by both scenarios and all repeats
clustering.preprocessing: Upstream removal of singleton families and collapse of perfectly co-occurring families; no sample-cluster presence filter
clustering.assignment: Unmodified upstream MMseqs all-versus-all search; chunked best-hit reduction preserves float32 identity/e-value ordering and first-file-order ties

outer_split: Recompute parent group_hosts and split_by_host_group, then require exact agreement with the committed host manifest; B2 follows retrieval_splits with near-clonal group purge
supervised_boundary: Feature selection, early stopping and hyperparameter selection receive only outer-training observed rows; neither outer validation nor test labels enter any fitting API

feature_selection.cutoff_choice: Fixed a priori; never select a row from GenoPHI's MCC-sorted performance table
feature_selection.window_rule: min_features <= feature count < max_features; stop as blocked if the fixed cutoff is outside the window; no fallback cutoff
feature_selection.rationale: Bounded comparator configuration; at most 5*200/3 features can pass cutoff 3, so max 501 is explicit and nonbinding

modeling.selection: Upstream MCC grid search and early stopping on internal folds of outer-training rows only; retain all 10 resulting models, without selecting runs on outer outcomes
modeling.refit: Preserve GenoPHI's internally split models; no all-outer-training refit or test-set early stopping

prediction: Rank all 94 phages by median positive-class confidence over all 30 models (3 complete feature-selection/modeling repeats x 10 internal modeling runs); also report each repeat's median and individual-model metric spread
variance_scope: Three complete same-machine replays use upstream's fixed internal run seeds; report their observed spread, including zero. This is repeatability, not independent sampling uncertainty or a user-controlled feature-selection seed sweep.

evaluation.tie_policy: Exact expectation over uniform within-score-tie permutations
evaluation.denominators: Report all complete-panel hosts and positive-eligible complete-panel hosts separately; exclude whole hosts with any unknown panel label

limitations: The shared protein-family vocabulary is transductive in genome sequences, as requested; supervised fitting is strictly outer-train-only. The earlier 4-mer representation is inductive.
This bounded GenoPHI configuration is an aligned comparator, not a reproduction of the authors' paper benchmark or an optimized GenoPHI result.
Scores target source-defined MLC positivity, not productive infection or clinical efficacy.
This is an already inspected development cohort and a fixed known-phage library, not an independent release holdout or an unseen-phage test.
